ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
ex.zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
ex.zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

tip: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

ex.en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。

ex.en: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
ex.zh: 蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。

tip: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

ex.en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
ex.zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。

ex.en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。

tip: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

tip: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

tip: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 very。

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 bad。

ex.en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
ex.zh: 那个男孩小心地抱着小狗跨过水坑。

ex.en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，每个男孩和女孩都应享有平等的受教育机会。

col: a teenage boy｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 通常指未成年男性；称成年男性为boy可能不礼貌。

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

col: slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

ex.en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。

ex.en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
ex.zh: 尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。

col: sorry for being late｜为迟到感到抱歉
sorry about the mistake｜为错误感到抱歉
feel sorry for someone｜同情某人
sorry to hear that｜听到那件事很难过
tip: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

ex.en: We packed nine apples for our picnic today.
ex.zh: 我们为今天的野餐装了九个苹果。

ex.en: The survey found that nine local schools had introduced cycling lessons to encourage more sustainable travel.
ex.zh: 调查发现，当地九所学校已开设骑行课程，以鼓励更可持续的出行。

col: nine times out of ten｜十有八九
tip: nine是基数词；序数词第九写作ninth。

ex.en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
ex.zh: 这个蛋盒里有十二枚新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: The training programme lasts twelve weeks and combines practical experience with classroom instruction for young adults.
ex.zh: 这项培训为期十二周，为年轻成年人提供实践经验与课堂教学相结合的学习。

tip: twelve是基数词；序数词twelfth拼写有变化。

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex.zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

ex.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

tip: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

ex.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
ex.zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。

ex.en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。

col: stick to a plan｜坚持计划
stick a picture on｜把图片贴在……上
tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
ex.zh: 大象用鼻子把水喷到自己的背上。

ex.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

col: a herd of elephants｜一群大象
tip: 复数为elephants；象鼻用trunk，不用nose。

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 pick。

ex.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。

ex.en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
ex.zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。

tip: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

ex.en: Please write your address on this small card.
ex.zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。

ex.en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

ex.en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。

ex.en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
ex.zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

col: a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

ex.en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
ex.zh: 我们每个周末都骑自行车去湖边。

ex.en: Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.
ex.zh: 更安全的自行车道可以鼓励更多居民在城市短途出行时骑车，而不是开车。

col: go for a ride｜骑车或乘车兜风
give someone a ride｜让某人搭车
tip: 不规则变化：ride—rode—ridden。

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。

tip: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

ex.en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
ex.zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？

ex.en: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。

col: an educated guess｜有依据的猜测
tip: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 piano。

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 violin。

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 guitar。

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 grandparent。

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
ex.zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

tip: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 parent。

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

tip: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

ex.en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。

ex.en: Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.
ex.zh: 平等的受教育机会确保女儿和儿子都能有相近的机会发展自身才能。

col: a teenage daughter｜十几岁的女儿
a mother and daughter｜一对母女
tip: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

ex.en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。

tip: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

ex.en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。

col: a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母
tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

ex.en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

tip: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。

ex.en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
ex.zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

tip: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。

ex.en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
ex.zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

col: be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

ex.en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
ex.zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

col: keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

ex.en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜几乎占满了整辆园艺推车。

ex.en: Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.
ex.zh: 科技巨头对人们获取信息和相互交流的方式有很大影响。

tip: 作形容词通常放名词前；作名词可指行业巨头。

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

ex.en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
ex.zh: 一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。

ex.en: Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
ex.zh: 栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。

col: a kangaroo's pouch｜袋鼠的育儿袋
tip: 复数直接加-s：kangaroos；育儿袋叫pouch。

ex.en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
ex.zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。

ex.en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。

col: long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

tip: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

ex.en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
ex.zh: 我们现在住在车站附近，步行过去很方便。

ex.en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
ex.zh: 既然在线课程已广泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同时继续接受教育。

tip: now that引导原因从句，强调情况已发生变化。

ex.en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
ex.zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。

ex.en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
ex.zh: 当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。

tip: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。

ex.en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
ex.zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

ex.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
ex.zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。

ex.en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
ex.zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

ex.en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
ex.zh: 她走在街上，包随着步伐轻轻摆动。

ex.en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
ex.zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。

col: swing back and forth｜来回摆动
a swing in public opinion｜舆论转变
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

ex.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
ex.zh: 在公园附近的环岛从第二个出口驶出。

ex.en: Replacing a busy junction with a roundabout may improve traffic flow and reduce serious collisions.
ex.zh: 将繁忙的交叉路口改为环岛可能改善车流，并减少严重碰撞事故。

col: take a roundabout route｜走迂回路线
in a roundabout way｜以迂回的方式
tip: 作形容词指不直接，如a roundabout answer。

ex.en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
ex.zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。

ex.en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
ex.zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。

tip: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 cable。

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 car。

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。

ex.en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
ex.zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 playground。

ex.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
ex.zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。

ex.en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。

tip: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

ex.en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
ex.zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。

col: sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
ex.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。

tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

ex.en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她打开了床边的灯。

ex.en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
ex.zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。

tip: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

ex.en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
ex.zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。

ex.en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
ex.zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。

tip: 复数是shelves；shelf life指保质期。

ex.en: The ox pulled a wooden cart along the path.
ex.zh: 那头役牛沿着小路拉着一辆木车。

ex.en: Before agricultural machinery became widespread, farmers in many regions relied on oxen to plough their fields.
ex.zh: 农业机械普及之前，许多地区的农民依靠役牛犁地。

col: a pair of oxen｜一对役牛
as strong as an ox｜健壮如牛
tip: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
ex.zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

tip: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 pencil。

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。
